summary.es: Update ligero de NY (08:49 CT): ETH y BTC siguieron cayendo tras el close y barrieron sin reclamo la zona de rebote en PDL/VAL de ayer que vigilabamos, superando el stop en las dos (zona rota). ETH cotiza en 1,615.19 (-3.34% en 24h) y BTC en 57,566.10 (-3.48% en 24h), los dos ya dentro de la extension completa de ayer y solapando un FVG alcista de 1h: confluencia nueva que el proximo crypto-close tiene que calificar, todavia sin puntuar. El fondeo de ETH paso de cargado de cortos a neutral, se cae el punto extra de apalancamiento de la zona ya rota. Miedo extremo sube un poco (13) y sin titular cripto fresco ni hueco de CME. La ventana de riesgo de Core PCE/PIB (13:15-14:00 UTC) ya paso y queda en null, sin otro evento de alto impacto hoy. summary.en: Light NY update (08:49 CT): ETH and BTC kept falling after the close and swept through the PDL/VAL bounce zone we were watching with no reclaim, breaking the stop on both (zone broken). ETH trades at 1,615.19 (-3.34% in 24h) and BTC at 57,566.10 (-3.48% in 24h), both already inside yesterday's full range extension and overlapping a 1h bullish FVG: a new confluence the next crypto-close has to grade, still unscored. ETH's funding flipped from shorts-crowded to neutral, dropping the extra leverage point from the zone that already broke. Extreme fear ticks up a bit (13) with no fresh crypto headline or CME gap. The Core PCE/GDP risk window (13:15-14:00 UTC) already passed and goes to null, no other high-impact event left today. Verdict: WAIT on both, no live A+ zone; watching the reaction at the extension/FVG for the next plan.
